Question 5
?

Which of the following sets of parametric equations, defined for t∈(−∞,∞), generate a vertical parabola that has its vertex at (3,3) and which passes through the point (7,5)?

a
x−3=4t,y−3=4t2
b
x−3=2t,y−3=t2
c
x+3=4t,y+3=2t2
d
x+3=2t,y+3=t2
e
x−3=4t,y−3=2t2
